import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
child = subprocess.Popen(["python3", "linger.py"], start_new_session=True, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
Path("child-pid.txt").write_text(str(child.pid))

from pathlib import Path
import time
Path("child-ready.txt").write_text("ready")
deadline = time.monotonic() + 45
while time.monotonic() < deadline:
    if Path("release-background.txt").exists():
        Path("after-server-exit-background.txt").write_text("late background write")
        break
    time.sleep(0.1)
